observations: Photo 0 is a small photo of a used inline 4 cylinder petrol car engine sitting on a wooden shelf in a parts shop.
The silver valve cover carries a Toyota emblem and red 'VVT-i' lettering, legible in photo 0.
Plastic intake manifold with long runners, throttle body, alternator and belt pulleys are fitted.
Heavy dust, dried mud and surface rust around the front of the head and timing cover; oily dirt on the block.
No engine code, stamped block number or label is readable in photo 0, so displacement and engine model are unknown.
Exhaust side, sump and the bell housing face are not shown.
Camera watermark 'CAMON 40' and a dealer name watermark appear on the photo.

identity.kind: used Toyota 4 cylinder VVT-i petrol engine, engine code not readable
read_from: photo 0 valve cover Toyota emblem and 'VVT-i' lettering

claims.claim: Direct America (foreign used, imported from the US)
claims.evidence: Origin cannot be shown in a photo of the engine; no import papers or US emission label shown.
Photo 0 shows heavy dust, dried mud and surface rust on the front of the head and timing cover.
No clip of the engine running or compression test shown.
A promise by the seller; no written terms shown, and it cannot be checked from photos.

risks.risk: Engine code is not the one the buyer needs, or is a lower value variant; code sets the price.
risks.proof: Clear close photo of the engine code and number stamped on the block, near the gearbox mounting face.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot set even a worst case without it.

risks.risk: Engine does not run, has low compression or burns oil.
risks.proof: Clip of the engine running on a test stand or in a car from cold start, with a compression gauge reading on each cylinder.

risks.risk: Cracked block or head, or water in the oil, hidden on sides not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the exhaust side, sump and a dipstick and oil filler cap close up.

risks.risk: Missing ancillaries such as the starter, wiring loom, sensors or ECU.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides listing what comes with it.

risks.risk: Photo is a dealer stock shot, not the engine sold.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped engine number next to a paper with the seller's name and today's date.
risks.if_unproven: As the worst unit of this type.

proof_requests: Close photo of the engine code and number stamped on the block.
Clip of the engine running from cold start.
Photos of the exhaust side, sump, dipstick and oil filler cap.
Engine number photo with a dated note from the seller.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used Toyota 4 cylinder VVT-i engine, but the engine code that decides which car it fits and so its price is not readable, and the seller does not even name one. A clear photo of the stamped engine code is needed before even a worst case price can be set.
